scope:
Radiation and nuclear first-order screens on fixed reversible source histories.
Radiation redistributes energy between shells and escapes at the outer boundary.
Entropy shifts are perturbative diagnostics; they are not a coupled new solution.

rate_update.interpolation: pchip in log(new/old) versus log(T9); frozen REACLIB shape supplies within-cell temperature dependence
rate_update.outside_table: Constant endpoint new/old ratio; relevant trajectories remain within table during burn.
rate_update.reverse_policy: Identical multiplicative factor for each forward/reverse pair, preserving the original library equilibrium ratio and Q.
rate_update.scope: Two carbon proton-capture pairs only; 27 species, other 190 rates, EOS, opacity, hydro and weak-energy convention unchanged.

postcontact_segment.scope: Each parcel is integrated only from its first backward contact-density crossing to the hot snapshot. Fluxes still use the auxiliary whole-fluid neighbors; contact boundary geometry must be resolved for a physical trajectory.

radiation.internal_transfer_scope: Spatial redistribution counted by crossed interfaces; not additional external energy loss.
